homeEyebrow: A companion on the way back
homeTitle: Every small movement brings you closer to life.
homeLead: An Arabic-first home rehabilitation space — safe exercises, a clear clinical follow-up, and the feeling that you are not doing this alone.
pathEyebrow: A clear path, from day one
pathTitle: Care that moves with you, not ahead of you.
step1Body: Add your medical file once, so your clinician can shape a plan around your day.
step2Body: Calm home sessions with visual guidance and gentle cues that protect you.
step3Body: Reports everyone can read, so you, your clinician, and your family choose the next step.
rolesTitle: You are in the right place
forPatientBody: Small steps, fitting sessions, and a steady sense that you are moving forward.
forDoctorBody: A clearer picture of daily movement and decisions grounded in visible data.
forCareBody: Real reassurance, without turning care into surveillance.
privacyTitle: Your privacy is not an extra.
privacyBody: Your medical file stays protected. Sharing with the clinical community happens only with your clear consent. You remain the decision maker.
humanBody: Faith in Life gathers what home recovery actually needs: plain language, trusted supervision, and signals that help someone step in at the right time.
footerNote: Recovery is a path worth living
chooseTitle: How will you join us today?
chooseLead: Welcome. Choose your role and we will shape the space around what you need.
rolePatientBody: Follow my exercises and see my progress
roleDoctorBody: Review cases and follow my patients
roleCareBody: Support the recovery path with calm
loginLead: Enter your details to reach your secure space.
registerLead: A small step toward a clearer recovery.
demoNote: After you create an account, use those details to sign in.
panelBody: A safe space that brings together your plan, your clinician, and the people who love you.
agree: I agree to the privacy policy and terms of use.
verifyLead: We sent a 6-digit code. Enter it to finish opening your account.
forgotLead: Enter your email and we will send a short reset code.
resetLead: Enter the code you received, then choose a new password.
notFoundBody: The link may have moved. We can take you somewhere familiar.
deniedTitle: This space is not for this account
deniedBody: Your current role cannot open this page. You can return to your own dashboard.
patientEmail: Patient email for a link request
patientHello: A quiet step today is enough. Stay with what you can do.
doctorHello: Your workspace is ready. Licenses and accounts show up here first.
careHello: Your calm presence matters. Follow only what is shared with you.
adminHello: Review accounts and licenses from here, without rush.
noMessage: When your clinician writes a note, it will appear here in plain language.
safety: If you feel severe pain or shortness of breath, stop the exercise and contact local emergency services.
noLinks: There are no link requests right now.
linkAsk: Ask to link with a patient
linkHelp: Search by exact email or national ID. The patient is the one who approves.
licensePending: Your license is waiting for an administrator. You can use the account; clinical follow-up opens after approval.
emptyModule: This section fills in when clinical data starts to arrive. The layout is ready; that care path is not switched on yet.
communityShare: Share anonymized data with the clinician community
noLicenses: No licenses are waiting for review.
noPatients: No patients are assigned yet. The list will appear here once care begins.
calmBody: There are no urgent alerts. We will tell you when your presence is needed.
careTeamBody: Messaging opens after the patient approves the link.
howBody: We walk with the patient from the first file to the home session, and keep the clinician and guardian looking at one understandable picture. AI modules will be added only after they are approved.
aboutBody: For the patient recovering at home, the clinician who wants movement follow-up without noise, and the guardian who wants reassurance without becoming a monitor.
privacyPage: Accounts use hashed passwords, short verification codes, and sessions you can end. Sharing with the clinician community requires the patient's consent, and a guardian link requires the patient's own approval.
codeSent: The verification code was sent to your Gmail. Open the message and enter the code here.
emailFailed: The message could not be sent to Gmail. Connect the Gmail account and try again.
serverDown: The server is not connected to the database. Try again in a moment.
